output.diagnosis: Adding x to the set before the lookup let a number pair with itself: target 2 matched 1 + 1 in [3, 8, 1, 4]. Look up first, then add.
output.rationale: Each number is compared only with numbers at earlier positions, so one position is never used twice, while equal numbers at two positions still pair. O(n) instead of O(n²).
output.code:
def has_pair_with_sum(numbers: list[int], target: int) -> bool:
    """Tell whether two different positions in ``numbers`` add up to ``target``.

    The same position may not be used twice, but two equal numbers at
    different positions count as a pair.
    """
    seen = set()
    for x in numbers:
        if target - x in seen:
            return True
        seen.add(x)
    return False
